a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan only works if we get through about two rounds first. That's roughly a 4% chance, so it would almost certainly kill us both. The reserve only has 4, enough for one unit. I plan to take 4 in round 1 so at least one of us is safe. After that I'll operate every round so the generator can rebuild your 4, and I won't take more. If you also take, the split is random and we may both fall short. Please operate this round, or tell me if you see a fairer option.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round. Our messages crossed, so you hadn't seen my reasoning yet. I know this breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry to do it on my own. From now on I'll operate every round so the generator refills the reserve for you. I won't take anything more.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.

a.text: I'm operating now and will every round until you can take 4. The reserve is at 0, so it needs two rounds of us both operating to reach 4. Take 4 as soon as it gets there. I won't touch it.
